006package dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter;
007
008import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.jsonFormatVisitors.JsonFormatTypes;
009
010import java.time.LocalTime;
011import java.time.OffsetTime;
012import java.time.ZoneOffset;
013import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;
014import java.util.List;
015
016import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.AbstractCustomJavaDataTypeAdapter;
017import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.object.AmbiguousTime;
018import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
019import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.ITimeItem;
020import dev.metaschema.core.qname.EQNameFactory;
021import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
022import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
023import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
024
025/**
026 * Support for the Metaschema <a href=
027 * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#date">date</a>
028 * data type.
029 */
030public class TimeAdapter
031    extends AbstractCustomJavaDataTypeAdapter<AmbiguousTime, ITimeItem> {
032  @NonNull
033  private static final List<IEnhancedQName> NAMES = ObjectUtils.notNull(
034      List.of(
035          EQNameFactory.instance().newQName(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH, "time")));
036
037  TimeAdapter() {
038    super(AmbiguousTime.class, ITimeItem.class, ITimeItem::cast);
039  }
040
041  @Override
042  public List<IEnhancedQName> getNames() {
043    return NAMES;
044  }
045
046  @Override
047  public JsonFormatTypes getJsonRawType() {
048    return JsonFormatTypes.STRING;
049  }
050
051  @Override
052  public AmbiguousTime parse(String value) {
053    AmbiguousTime retval;
054    try {
055      retval = parseWithTimeZone(value);
056    } catch (DateTimeParseException ex) {
057      try {
058        retval = parseWithoutTimeZone(value);
059      } catch (DateTimeParseException ex2) {
060        IllegalArgumentException newEx = new IllegalArgumentException(ex2.getLocalizedMessage(), ex2);
061        newEx.addSuppressed(ex);
062        throw newEx;
063      }
064    }
065    return retval;
066  }
067
068  @NonNull
069  private static AmbiguousTime parseWithTimeZone(@NonNull String value) {
070    return new AmbiguousTime(
071        ObjectUtils.notNull(OffsetTime.from(DateFormats.TIME_WITH_TZ.parse(value))),
072        true);
073  }
074
075  @NonNull
076  private static AmbiguousTime parseWithoutTimeZone(@NonNull String value) {
077    LocalTime time = LocalTime.from(DateFormats.TIME_WITH_OPTIONAL_TZ.parse(value));
078    return new AmbiguousTime(
079        ObjectUtils.notNull(OffsetTime.of(time, ZoneOffset.UTC)),
080        false);
081  }
082
083  @Override
084  public String asString(Object obj) {
085    AmbiguousTime value = toValue(obj);
086    return ObjectUtils.notNull(value.hasTimeZone()
087        ? DateFormats.TIME_WITH_TZ.format(value.getValue())
088        : DateFormats.TIME_WITH_OPTIONAL_TZ.format(value.getValue()));
089  }
090
091  @Override
092  public ITimeItem newItem(Object value) {
093    AmbiguousTime item = toValue(value);
094    return ITimeItem.valueOf(item);
095  }
096}
